additions.description: עורב (raven) = מסירת נפש, ביטול עצמות וגשמיות (the raven = self-nullification / complete self-sacrifice in prayer)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 17): 'וַאֲתֵי פּוּשְׁקַנְצָא וּבְלַעֵהּ – פֵּרֵשׁ רַשִׁ"י: עוֹרֵב; וְאָמְרוּ חֲכָמֵינוּ: מִי שֶׁמַּשְׁחִיר פָּנָיו כְּעוֹרֵב, הַיְנוּ שֶׁמִּתְפַּלֵּל בְּלִי שׁוּם כַּוָּנַת תּוֹעֶלֶת עַצְמוֹ, וְנִתְבַּטֵּל כָּל עַצְמוּתוֹ וְגַשְׁמִיּוּתוֹ. וְזֶה בְּחִינַת שְׁחוֹרוֹת כְּעוֹרֵב'
additions.notes: The raven (עורב / פושקנצא) IS the person who nullifies all self-interest in prayer — בחינת מסירת נפש. It is the positive instrument of prayer that reaches hidden Torah. This bechina is stated explicitly in the text and is a critical link between Package 5 (Prayer) and Package 6 (Hidden Torah). Its absence leaves the mechanism connecting them invisible in the bechina graph.

additions.description: אקרא דהגרוניא = תורה שבנגלה (the walled city of Hagroniah = Revealed Torah — spoken aloud from the throat)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 13): 'וְדַמְיָא לְאַקְרָא דְּהַגְרוֹנְיָא – לְשׁוֹן קְרָא בְגָרוֹן, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּנִגְלֶה, כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ: לְמוֹצִיאֵיהֶם בַּפֶּה'
additions.notes: The walled city of Hagroniah = תורה שבנגלה. The Aramaic 'akra' = fortified city (accessible to all, like public Torah), and 'hagroniah' = throat/voice (Torah that is spoken aloud = public Torah). This is an explicit bechina stated in the text but missing from the dataset. Would reinforce Package 4.

additions.description: אקרוקתא (the frog) = דעת — as the combined symbol צפור+דעה (the frog IS the bechina of yirah rising to its root daat)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 12): 'אַקְרוּקְתָא... צְפַרְדֵּעַ, וְזֶה בְּחִינַת עֲלִיַּת הַיִּרְאָה לְשָׁרְשָׁהּ, הַיְנוּ דַּעַת'
additions.notes: While the dataset has an edge צפרדע—עלית היראה לשרשה (which is correct), it is missing the direct bechina צפרדע = דעת. The Rebbe states: 'this is the bechina of ascending yirah to its root, namely daat.' The deat-half of the frog's compound name explicitly makes it a bechina of daat. This edge would create a bridge between Package 1 (יראה, which contains צפרדע) and Package 2 (דעת), reflecting the Torah's core claim that yirah and daat are structurally connected.

additions.description: אילנא = עולם הבא (the great tree = the World to Come, where souls dwell)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 18-19): 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת: סְלֵיק וִיתִב בְּאִילָנָא – שֶׁשָּׁם מְדוֹר הַנְּשָׁמוֹת... וְהוּא בְּחִינַת עוֹלָם הַבָּא'
additions.notes: The great tree (אילנא) = the World to Come, where all souls originate and dwell. 'כל נשמתין מאילנא רבא נפקין' (Zohar Mishpatim). The World to Come is essentially equated with תורה שבנסתר in this teaching (what cannot be apprehended within finite limits). Would join Package 6 (Hidden Torah / Temple / unbounded dimension). This bechina is stated in the text but missing from the dataset for reference 15.

additions.description: שחורות כעורב = חשך = תורה שבנסתר (dark as a raven = the darkness = hidden Torah)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ה (line 17-18): 'וְזֶה בְּחִינַת שְׁחוֹרוֹת כְּעוֹרֵב... כִּי הֵם בְּחִינַת חשֶׁךְ עַל שֵׁם עֹמֶק הַמֻּשָּׂג'
additions.notes: 'Black like a raven' from Song of Songs 5:11 is explicitly equated with חשך — the darkness of the hidden Torah (its depth of apprehension transcends all light/form). The dataset has חשך — תורה שבנסתר, but is missing the explicit bechina שחורות כעורב = חשך. Would strengthen Package 6 by connecting the Song of Songs image to the hidden Torah cluster.

additions.description: הולך בדרך תמים = תפלה / אברהם (one who walks in a perfect way = prayer, bechina of Abraham)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ח (line 42): 'הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים – זֶה בְּחִינוֹת תְּפִלָּה, בְּחִינַת אַבְרָהָם כַּנַּ"ל, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב: הִתְהַלֵּךְ לְפָנַי וֶהְיֵה תָמִים'
additions.notes: 'He who walks in a perfect way' (Psalms 101:2, 'לשבת עמדי') = the bechina of prayer / Abraham ('התהלך לפני והיה תמים' — Abraham's command). This is an explicit bechina in the final section's midrash passage. Would add another node to Package 5 (Prayer/Abraham).

additions.description: הוא ישרתני = סתרי אוריתא / עולם הבא / הוא (one who will serve me = hidden Torah, the aspect of HU/He/World to Come)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ח (line 43): 'הוּא יְשָׁרְתֵנִי – זֶה בְּחִינַת סִתְרֵי אוֹרַיְתָא, זֶה בְּחִינַת הוּא, בְּחִינוֹת עוֹלָם הַבָּא'
additions.notes: 'He will serve me' (Psalms 101:6) = the bechina of hidden Torah, the bechina of 'הוא' (He — the concealed, beyond-form name, = World to Come per Zohar Vayetze). This is an explicit bechina in the midrashic application section. Would add another node to Package 6.

additions.description: לשבת עמדי = סיני / שפלות (to dwell with me = Sinai / humility)
additions.source_text_ref: Section ח (line 41): 'לָשֶׁבֶת עִמָּדִי – זֶה בְּחִינוֹת סִינַי, שִׁפְלוּת, אֶשְׁכֹּן אֶת דַּכָּא'
additions.notes: 'To dwell with me' (Psalms 101:6) = the bechina of Sinai / humility (Isaiah 57:15 'I dwell with the lowly'). Explicit bechina in the midrash section. Would reinforce Package 4 (Revealed Torah / Sinai / Humility).

structural_observations: Torah 15 has a beautifully clear 4-stage linear structure: יראה (Package 1) → via דעת (Package 2) and משפט (Package 3) → yields תורה שבנגלה (Package 4) → yields תפלה (Package 5) → yields סתרי אוריתא (Package 6). The eitza edges flow in exactly this sequence.

The good/evil mirror is present but minimal: the main evil force (Package 7: נחש/תנינא) is the corrupted prayer that seeks self-benefit. This is the structural antithesis of Package 5 (pure prayer as chesed). The Torah's resolution is the raven (פושקנצא) swallowing the serpent — self-nullification overcoming self-seeking.

Five divine acquisitions from Avot 6 map exactly to the five positive packages: Torah = Package 4 (Revealed Torah); Heaven & Earth = Package 2 (Daat) + Package 1 (Yirah); Abraham = Package 5 (Prayer/Chesed); Israel = Package 3 (Mishpat); Temple = Package 6 (Hidden Torah).

The Raba bar bar Chana allegory (Aramaic) in section ה is the central narrative vehicle. Most of its key bechina equations ARE captured in the dataset. The main gaps are: the raven's explicit bechina identity, and the city-of-Hagroniah as tורה שבנגלה.

Section ח adds a parallel set of bechina equations via Psalm 101:6 ('עיני בנאמני ארץ'), which ARE captured (בנאמני—אהרן, ארץ—יראה, עיני—דעת). The final verse applications in section ז (ממלכת כהנים) are also captured (ממלכת—תורה שבנגלה, כהן—תפלה). Coverage is strong for the main sections.
